records.interpretation_limit: Median per-night accuracy on different data cannot be ranked directly against the local five-fold mean epoch accuracy. The published training list excludes APPLES; the provenance of any downloaded weight version still needs checking.

local_recalculations.constant_predictor: For each outer split, predict every test subject using the mean target of the training subjects only.
local_recalculations.loso_outer_split: Each distinct site is held out; the other sites supply the training prevalence.
local_recalculations.interpretation_limit: No new model was fitted. Brier compares probability error, not individual discrimination. Existing weighted E4 scores have different calibration properties.
